citation: The UniProt Consortium. UniProt: the Universal Protein Knowledgebase in 2025. Nucleic Acids Research 53, D609-D617 (2025). Reviewed (Swiss-Prot) human entries retrieved via the REST stream endpoint.
notes: 20,431 manually reviewed human entries, pulled with fields accession, gene_primary, protein_name, cc_function, go_id, annotation_score, protein_existence, xref_geneid, cc_caution. The cc_function free text is the curated statement of what the protein does and is used here as the human-side ground truth for whether a gene is characterized at all; ECO evidence braces are stripped during parsing. This project already used UniProt ortholog records in Session 22 to corroborate the JCVISYN3A_0876 x 0878 synthetic-lethal pair, so the same authority applies at human scale here.
